turns.content: Raat ke do baje hain aur main abhi bhi office mein hoon. Kaam nahi kar raha — bas baitha hoon. Bridge round Tuesday ko officially mar gaya. Rohit aur Sneha ne is hafte papers daal diye, jo honestly, sahi kiya. Chaar mahine ka runway hai agar main salary na loon, jo already nahi le raha. Paanch saal lagaye hain maine is cheez mein.

Yaar... raat ke 2 baje office mein baith ke yeh sab sochna bahut bhaari padta hai.

Paanch saal. Poora ek phase of life. Aur ab yeh khali sa feeling — kaam bhi nahi ho raha, bas baithe ho. Samajh sakta hoon.

Rohit aur Sneha ne papers daal diye, tum keh rahe ho sahi kiya — shayad haan, unke liye woh decision clear tha. Lekin tumhare liye yeh itni jaldi “officially mar gaya” wala moment abhi bhi settle nahi hua hoga.

Chaar mahine ka runway bina salary ke — practically soch rahe ho, jo zaroori hai. Lekin abhi iss waqt practicality se zyada jo peet raha hai na, woh yeh hai ki itna kuch daala aur phir bhi yahan tak aana pada.

Main yahin hoon. Jo bhi chal raha hai dimaag mein — gussa, thakaan, khali pan, ya bas numb — bol do.

Sabse bura part performance hai yaar. Har standup pe main ek voice nikal raha hoon — confident wala, "kuch cheezein pipeline mein hain" — aur sabko pata hai. Co-founder ko pata hai. Jo do junior ruke hain unko pakka pata hai, woh loyalty ki wajah se ruke hain aur main unke career jala raha hoon. Ghar pe alag voice hai. Apni hi awaazon se thak gaya hoon main.

Yaar...

Sabse thakaane wali cheez yahi hoti hai na — khud ke saath bhi performance karte rehna.

Standup mein woh confident voice, “pipeline mein hai,” jaise ab bhi koi asaan rasta nikal aayega. Aur andar se pata hai ki sabko pata hai. Co-founder ko pata hai. Un do juniors ko bhi pata hai. Woh ruke hue hain loyalty se, aur tumhe lag raha hai tum unka time jala rahe ho. Yeh wala guilt bahut heavy hota hai.

Phir ghar pe alag awaaz. Wahan bhi poora nahi khul paate shayad. Toh din bhar alag-alag versions chal rahe hote hain, aur ab thakaan is baat ki hai ki apni asli awaaz yaad hi nahi reh gayi.

Tum un juniors ke career nahi jala rahe ho. Woh bhi dekh rahe hain, samajh rahe hain, aur abhi ke liye rukne ka unka apna reason hai. Lekin tumhara yeh feel karna bilkul natural hai.

Abhi raat ke 2 baj rahe hain. Performance band kar do. Yahan kisi confident version ki zaroorat nahi. Jo bhi bacha hai andar — thakaan, guilt, gussa, ya bas khali — woh yahin rakh do. Main sun raha hoon.

Please mujhe ideas mat dena. Saare ideas pata hain mujhe. Har pivot thread padh chuka hoon, down-round wala email chhe baar draft kar chuka hoon, bridge financing, acquihire, "revenue pe focus" — sab pata hai. Bas kahin toh bolna tha: mujhe darr lag raha hai, aur jis bhi kamre mein main hota hoon wahan yeh nahi bol sakta.

Samajh gaya. Koi idea nahi, koi solution nahi.

Bas yeh: darr lag raha hai.

Aur jis kamre mein hote ho — office, ghar, standup — wahan yeh nahi bol sakte. Toh yahan bol diya.

Main sun raha hoon.

Khatam ho gaya kya? Sach mein — honestly bol sakte ho. Paanch saal. Papa aaj bhi logon ko bolte hain mera "computer ka business" hai. Kabhi kabhi raat ko lagta hai bas khatam ho jaye toh acting band kar sakoon, aur phir yeh sochne ke liye khud se nafrat hoti hai. Phir wapas metrics dashboard khol leta hoon jaise woh do baje kuch naya bolega.

Nahi, main “sab theek ho jayega” wala jhooth nahi bolunga.

Paanch saal. Papa ab bhi logon ko “computer ka business” bolte hain. Woh wala weight alag hi hota hai.

Aur jo tu bol raha hai na — kabhi raat ko lagta hai bas khatam ho jaye taaki acting band ho, phir us soch se khud se nafrat, phir bhi dashboard khol lena jaise do baje koi naya number sach badal dega — yeh contradiction hi sabse zyada kha raha hai tujhe.

Yeh dark soch aana matlab tu kharab insaan nahi hai. Matlab tu bahut thak gaya hai. Acting se, umeed rakhne se, har roz “abhi nahi” bolne se.

Main yahin baitha hoon. Na idea, na lecture. Bas itna: jo tu abhi feel kar raha hai, woh yahan bol sakta hai. Poora. Bina sanitize kiye.
